title: Pan-Seared Paneer with Algerian Spices
description: A unique Italian-inspired dish that combines the creaminess of paneer with the bold flavors of Algerian spices. Serve as a main course or a side dish.

ingredients.name: algerian spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add zucchini and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add cherry tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add algerian spices and stir to combine.
Add paneer to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side until golden brown.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
